headline: China Reduces Stock Margin Ratio to 80% to Support Market Liquidity
summary: The China Securities Regulatory Commission approved the Shanghai and Shenzhen stock exchanges to lower the minimum margin ratio for investors from 100% to 80%, aiming to boost trading activity and halt equity declines.
why: The China Securities Regulatory Commission regulates Chinese capital markets, where policy shifts directly affect domestic liquidity and market stability.

impacts.name: SSE Composite Index
impacts.why: Lowering margin requirements allows investors to leverage more funds, increasing market liquidity.
